parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The bastion host ID.

>  You can call the [DescribeInstances](~~153281~~) operation to query the bastion host ID.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the bastion host.
> For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see [Regions and zones](~~40654~~).

parameters.name: TokenId
parameters.description:
The ID of the O\&M token that you want to renew.

>  You can call the [GenerateAssetOperationToken](~~2758861~~) operation to query the O\&M token ID.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun yundun-bastionhost renew-asset-operation-token --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --token-id NmYyMmEzNmMwYzljNGYxMjh000000 --region cn-hangzhou
